title: Application Timekeeping Timesyncd Entity
description: systemd-timesyncd specific configuration. Lightweight SNTP client built into systemd.

root_distance_max_sec.description: Maximum acceptable root distance in seconds (default: 5).

connection_retry_sec.description: Seconds to wait before retrying a failed connection (default: 30).

save_interval_sec.description: Interval for saving clock state to disk.
